description.fun: Jirachi sleeps for a thousand years at a time, waking for just seven days, and during that short time it grants wishes; a pure singing voice can also wake it. The tags on its head look like tanzaku, the paper strips people write wishes on for Japan's Tanabata star festival, and its seven waking days may echo the festival falling on the seventh day of the seventh month. A hidden 'true eye' sits on its belly.
description.guide: A Steel- and Psychic-type Mythical Pokémon based on wishing upon a star, which wakes for only seven days every thousand years. It is the only Pokémon that can learn Doom Desire. It does not evolve.
description.tagline: A wish-granting star that wakes for seven days every thousand years
